sentences.text:
(i) In the event of arrest of the applicant in C.R.No. 978 of 2021 registered with Manmad City Police Station, Manmad, District- Nashik for the offences punishable under Sections 179, 188, 272, 273 and 328 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 26 (2) (i), 26 (2) (iv), 59 and 27 (2) (e) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, the applicant be enlarged on bail on his furnishing PR & SB in the sum of Rs.
20,000/- with one or two surety/sureties in like amount.
(ii) The applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by a police officer of concerned police station as and when required.
(iii) The applicant shall not tamper with prosecution evidence.
(iv) Issue notice to the concerned police station, returnable on 13th January, 2022.
(v) This order shall remain in force till the next date.

opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
However, having regard to the  facts and circumstances of the case, prima facie the  applicability of Section 328 of the Indian Penal Code appears  to be doubtful.
The applicant, therefore, has made out a case  for ad-interim protection.

Hence the following order is  passed :

20,000/- with one or two surety/sureties in like amount.
(ii) The applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by a police officer of concerned police station as and when required.
(iii) The applicant shall not tamper with prosecution evidence.
(iv) Issue notice to the concerned police station, returnable on 13th January, 2022.
(v) This order shall remain in force till the next date.
